fields.name: faqsDescription
fields.default_value: Still curious? Our product specialists are here to help.

fields.label: FAQ 1 Question
fields.name: faq1Question
fields.default_value: How quickly can our team get started?

fields.label: FAQ 1 Answer
fields.name: faq1Answer
fields.default_value: Most teams launch their first workspace in under a day. Our guided setup, templates, and import tools make onboarding fast and low-risk.

fields.label: FAQ 2 Question
fields.name: faq2Question
fields.default_value: Can LumaCore replace our existing tools?

fields.label: FAQ 2 Answer
fields.name: faq2Answer
fields.default_value: Yes, or it can seamlessly orchestrate them. LumaCore is designed to either unify point tools into one workspace or act as the coordinating intelligence layer over your existing software stack.

fields.label: FAQ 3 Question
fields.name: faq3Question
fields.default_value: Is it suitable for enterprise organizations?

fields.label: FAQ 3 Answer
fields.name: faq3Answer
fields.default_value: Absolutely. Built with multi-region redundancy, granular RBAC, SSO/SCIM integration, and compliant with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.

fields.label: FAQ 4 Answer
fields.name: faq4Answer
fields.default_value: Every enterprise tier includes dedicated solution architect onboarding, 24/7 priority SLA support, and regular architecture reviews.
